propertySets.name: Pset_RailTypeStockRail
propertySets.definition: Properties common to IfcRail types and occurrences with PredefinedType set to STOCKRAIL.

properties.name: StockRailRadius
properties.definition: The radius of the stock rail bend defined as design parameter.

properties.name: InstallationPlan
properties.definition: Reference to external information source about installation or construction plan of the element.

properties.name: NominalLength
properties.definition: The nominal overall length of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In case of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.
